Success reveals whether the target believes a given statement is true or false; a deliberately misleading half-truth (omitting details a listener would draw wrong conclusions from) reads as false, and a multi-point statement with any false point reads entirely false. With the Microscopic Lens submodule of Optical Enhancement, the same roll can scrutinize written text for deception (difficulty equal to the author's Manipulation rating at time of writing), limited to languages the Exalt understands. Sensory and Spiritual Charms tree (Perception-keyed).
prerequisiteText: Chemical Analysis System or Tympanal Receptor Upgrade

name: Mobile Sensory Drone
summary: A replaced eye that detaches into a tendril-legged automaton sharing all the Exalt's senses and Abilities, telepathically relaying everything it perceives back to her, with seven optional submodules (Autonomous, Communication, Hovering, Injection Needle, Playback, Stealth, Flesh-Burrowing).
description: The drone has Dexterity = Exalt's Dexterity + Essence; Perception and all Abilities equal the Exalt's own (opponents suffer +2 difficulty to hit it, and it fits through any inch-wide opening); Strength 1 (feats of strength capped at the Exalt's Essence regardless of Athletics); Stamina/soak(L/B)/health levels equal to the Exalt's Essence, losing 1 Perception dot per health level lost and dissolving if destroyed or if commitment is withdrawn (the socket regrows a replacement in a day); tentacle-leg attacks (speed +0, accuracy +0, damage 1L, defense -2; rate 3 under Exalted Power Combat); double the Exalt's running speed with insect-like surface adhesion; and a range cap of the Exalt's Essence in miles for control/transmission, auto-retreating toward the Exalt's last known position if blocked or out of range (the link counts as an arcane link, and anti-scrying wards block it). Multiple drones may be installed (installations beyond the first skip the installation cost and are mounted as inconspicuous rivets elsewhere on the body). Submodules (2 bonus points/6 experience points each): Autonomous (Intelligence 1 plus one Ability dot the Exalt has, acting independently, fleeing if attacked unless ordered otherwise); Communication (relays/transmits the Exalt's voice, audibly distorted); Hovering (flight at running speed instead of scuttling); Injection Needle (requires Multifunction Hypodermic Apparatus; delivers one stored drug dose via the drone's Dexterity + the Exalt's Medicine); Playback (records experiences to a memory crystal, downloaded on return to the socket); Stealth (gains Optical Shroud-equivalent concealment while motionless a full turn, lost on any movement unless passively anchored to a moving perch); Flesh-Burrowing (Essence 3+; a Dexterity + Medicine attack, difficulty 2, lets the drone burrow into a wounded target and ride its senses until it exits via the same attack or is surgically removed, difficulty 3, dealing 1L either way). Sensory and Spiritual Charms tree (Perception-keyed); root of a Perception branch.
prerequisiteText: Transitory or Sustained Augmentation of Perception

name: Interpolative Situational Analysis Processor
summary: A cognitive-cluster implant that gathers and filters all of an Alchemical's sensory data into pertinent investigative details and speculative connections, functioning as a Storyteller-guided detective aid.
description: Roll Wits + (Awareness or Investigation, whichever is higher) at standard difficulty. Each success reveals or recalls one detail most relevant to a single line of inquiry (including details from earlier scenes), which the Storyteller combines with speculative hints connecting them (e.g. reconstructing a murder scene's blood spatter, body position, and wound nature, plus an inference about the killer's skill and relationship to the victim). The Storyteller should offer a mix of plausible truths and red herrings without answering the question outright; if the true answer is wholly unexpected or actively concealed by misdirection, the Charm may produce false suppositions. Sensory and Spiritual Charms tree (Wits-keyed); root of the Wits branch.
prerequisiteText: Both Transitory and Sustained Augmentation of Wits

name: Soulgem Detector
summary: A forehead-mounted stud wired to an Alchemical's own soulgem that detects every soulgem within range, distinguishing whether each holds a soul and whether it is set into a mortal, an Exalt, or no one, with more powerful long-range variants at higher Essence.
description: Detects every soulgem within (Perception x 10) yards, automatically knowing whether a gem holds a soul and its implantation status, though only one gem's Essence pattern can be diceless-focused on at a time; a soulgem capped in lead becomes invisible to this Charm (a highly illegal procedure). A more powerful variant (Perception 3, Essence 5) extends range to (Perception x 100) yards, and a greater variant (Perception 6, Essence 8) extends it to (Perception) miles. Sensory and Spiritual Charms tree (Perception-keyed); root of a Perception branch.
prerequisiteText: Transitory or Sustained Augmentation of Perception

name: Cross-Phase Scanner
summary: Facial receptor nodules attuning an Alchemical's senses to immaterial energies, letting her perceive spirits and other incorporeal phenomena as if solid, one sense at a time.
description: For every 2 motes spent, the Exalt may perceive spirits, sanctum entrances, and other incorporeal beings/effects as if they were solid, through one designated sense; such phenomena carry a faint but distinctive tone, color, or other tell that identifies them, and the Exalt never confuses immaterial for material or vice versa. Sensory and Spiritual Charms tree (Perception-keyed).
cost: 2 motes per sense; Installation Cost: 1 mote.
prerequisiteText: Transitory or Sustained Augmentation of Perception

name: Transphase Engine
summary: A starmetal-sphere implant letting an Alchemical briefly dematerialize into a translucent phantom state in conjunction with an instant action such as an attack, dodge, parry, or Athletics maneuver.
description: Activated for 4 motes alongside a dice action of instant duration: an attack (letting her strike a dematerialized being), a dodge (becoming a limited 'perfect' defense against a material attack that cannot affect dematerialized beings), a parry (only useful against immaterial beings), an Athletics maneuver (phasing through a door or floor), or another Storyteller-approved use. Integrated mass sensors prevent activation if the character would end the split-second phase still partway through a heavy obstruction (wall, floor, ceiling), so a running dash into a thick wall while relying on this Charm fails embarrassingly or painfully. Sensory and Spiritual Charms tree (Wits-keyed).

name: God-Ward Projector
summary: A spine-mounted mechanism that emits an expanding, then-fixed spherical barrier of glowing Essence blocking spirit passage and most spirit Charms from crossing in either direction.
description: Expands to a maximum radius of (Charisma x 5) yards before crystallizing invisibly (though translucent to dematerialized beings) and barring passage to any spirit regardless of power; it also blocks spirits outside from affecting anyone/anything inside with their Charms unless their permanent Essence exceeds the Alchemical's Charisma. Spirits already inside when it hardens may act and remain freely; leaving causes a tingling sensation and bars reentry. Materialized spirits (or any spirit possessing a host) cross freely. The ward persists fixed in place until the Alchemical dies or moves outside it, at which point it immediately collapses. Sensory and Spiritual Charms tree (Charisma-keyed).

name: Sustenance Replication Engine
summary: A stomach-linked reactor and digestive recycler that lets an Alchemical divide her food requirement by her Essence (or eliminate it at Essence 5+ for an upkeep cost), and can also bleed out an edible nutrient paste for feeding mortals.
description: The Exalt produces no waste and divides the food needed to stay healthy by her permanent Essence. Essence 5+ Alchemicals may forgo nourishment entirely, synthesizing nutrients directly from Essence for an uncommitted upkeep of 5 motes per day; failing to pay it (or failing to eat if not using that option) leads to ordinary starvation penalties. Secondary function: bleeding a bland, chalky but nutritionally complete gray paste from a forearm vein port, enough to feed one mortal one meal for 5 motes and one minute of bleeding; such meals contain negligible Essence and give Alchemicals no benefit. Medical Charms tree (Stamina-keyed); root of the tree.
cost: None, or 5 motes; Installation Cost: 1 mote.

name: Toxicity Filtration Subsystems
summary: A body-wide filtration network that gives an Alchemical automatic bonus successes against poison and expunges alcohol/drugs from her system, at the cost of never being able to get drunk or high even when desired.
description: When activated by exposure to a toxin, the Exalt adds her Essence in automatic successes to Stamina rolls and soak against the poison, and expunges alcohol/recreational drugs from her body; if her player rolls more than double the successes needed to reduce a poisoning's severity, the chemical has no effect at all. The Charm activates itself automatically whenever exposed to a dangerous toxin (conscious characters may deliberately suppress it), which as a side effect prevents the Alchemical from ever becoming drunk or high without deliberate suppression. Medical Charms tree (Stamina-keyed); root of a Stamina branch.
prerequisiteText: Transitory or Sustained Augmentation of Stamina

name: Biofunction Inhibitor
summary: A control-valve implant letting an Alchemical enter deathlike regenerative torpor to rest far faster than sleep, accelerating both Essence recovery and Willpower recovery.
description: Over about a minute, all biological processes and Charms slow to a stop until the Exalt appears dead (anyone who knows Alchemical biology recognizes this isn't true death since the body would otherwise dissolve; a trained medic can detect faint life signs with Perception + Medicine, difficulty 4). The Exalt must specify the intended torpor duration when activating and remains fully unaware of her surroundings, only waking early if something could have damaged her (regardless of whether damage is actually applied). Time in torpor is more restful than sleep by a factor of the Exalt's permanent Essence (e.g. an Essence 4 Alchemical compresses a full night's rest into two hours). Torpor also speeds Willpower recovery, but only one Conviction roll is allowed per 25-hour period, and Essence respiration during torpor is no faster than normal sleep. Medical Charms tree (Stamina-keyed).
prerequisiteText: Transitory or Sustained Augmentation of Stamina

name: Restorative Fusion Transponder
summary: A spinal port letting an Alchemical, while resting on a natural Autochthonian surface, cocoon herself in Primordial cables and heal/recover Essence as if resting in a Vat Complex.
description: Activating on a natural surface causes cables and Primordial capillaries to rise and cocoon the Exalt, culminating in a spike docking into the spinal port and rendering her unconscious while her body heals and regains Essence at Vat Complex rates; even starving characters can respire Essence and heal within a cocoon, albeit only at their usual rates. Cocoons have soak 10L/15B and 10 levels of durability before breaking (which wakes the Exalt); otherwise they remain until the Exalt voluntarily dismisses them (even while unconscious, she can track her recovery progress and order withdrawal), after which the ground seals without a trace. Medical Charms tree (Stamina-keyed).

name: Body-Reweaving Matrix
summary: Hidden colonies of thumbnail-sized spider-automata that swarm across an Alchemical's body to accelerate healing dramatically, regrowing amputated limbs, organs, and even destroyed Charms installed at the time of injury.
description: While active, the Alchemical regenerates a number of bashing levels per turn equal to her permanent Essence; lethal damage heals at one level per turn; aggravated damage heals at one level per 10 hours. Amputated/destroyed organs heal as aggravated damage: whole limbs count as three levels, partial limbs (forearm+hand, or leg from the knee down) as two levels, and hands/eyes/a mouthful of teeth as one level. Any Charms located in an amputated area regrow too, but only those installed as of the time of injury; the amputated originals disintegrate as the Matrix replaces them. Medical Charms tree (Stamina-keyed).

name: Diagnostic Sensor Apparatus
summary: Fingertip sensors that scan a nearby living target's vital signs into an Alchemical's memory for later medical analysis, revealing progressively more diagnostic detail with more time spent interpreting the scan.
description: Scanning costs 1 mote and a turn, targeting a living being within the Exalt's Essence in yards; results remain stored in memory as long as Essence is committed to remembering them. Interpreting the scan requires Intelligence + Medicine at standard difficulty, five minutes per roll, poolable as an extended action; a character knows everything at or below her rolled successes: one success (alive/dead, well or diseased/infected), two (number of ailments), three (physical location of all ailments), four (progression and names of known ailments, plus recovery variables like Stamina/Endurance/Resistance), five (full profiling including vectors, symptoms, and whether an ailment is magical). Once the character stops analyzing, the raw scan data and its Essence commitment fade, leaving only the diagnosis reached so far. Medical Charms tree (Perception-keyed); root of the Perception branch.
prerequisiteText: Transitory or Sustained Augmentation of Perception

name: Biosight Reticle
summary: Diagnostic eye-lenses that render Essence-bearing beings visible through obstructions and darkness by their inner glow, can pierce many concealment Charms, and let the Alchemical read a detailed vital-signs profile of a studied target.
description: Grants bonus dice equal to a hidden target's own permanent Essence to spot them with Perception rolls; negates visual penalties from darkness/fog/smoke/etc. for spotting or attacking animate targets, and can scan through a cumulative yard or more of solid matter before being blocked. Automatically dulls the Great Maker's ambient Essence glow in Autochthonia to background flicker (unfiltered in Creation, letting it reveal Demesnes, Manses, and dragon tracks). Can pierce concealment Charms of equal-or-lesser-Essence characters unless the magic specifically cloaks Essence emanations or relies on mental misdirection, via an opposed roll of (Perception + Awareness + the target's Essence) versus (the target's Dexterity + Stealth); winning spots the target, losing lets their Charm function normally. Once aware of a target, a simple action plus a Perception + Medicine roll reveals one piece of chosen vital information per success: current/maximum health levels, current wound/fatigue penalties, permanent Essence, current Essence pool, Stamina/Endurance/Resistance ratings, injury locations, pregnancy, parasites, disease, or infected-wound locations; further turns of scanning can reveal more (a botch always yields erroneous results). Medical Charms tree (Perception-keyed).

name: Biostasis Field Projector
summary: A palm-mounted capacitor that induces a coma-like stasis in a touched patient, halting bleeding/infection/poison progression, and can be used reflexively on the Alchemical herself to survive damage that would otherwise be lethal.
description: Touch-activated (3 motes); the patient convulses and falls into an apparently-dead stasis detectable as alive only via Perception + Medicine (difficulty 4) or diagnostic magic/Essence sight. Requires several seconds of contact, so it cannot be paired with an unarmed strike to incapacitate an unwilling target, but may substitute for damage after winning control of a clinch; an unwilling patient may resist with Stamina + Resistance (difficulty = the Exalt's Essence). While stabilized, infections/poisons halt spreading, bleeding stops, and mortally wounded patients do not deteriorate past Incapacitated; stasis lasts a day (or until Essence commitment is withdrawn) and is renewable, with 'unfreezing' returning the patient to their exact condition at administration (any new injuries in the interim remain). Used for battlefield first aid, surgical anesthesia, and prisoner transport. Alchemicals may use it on themselves for any specified duration but remain helplessly unconscious until it runs its course; they may also activate it reflexively (3 motes and a recoverable dot of Stamina) when lethal damage would drop them below Incapacitated, entering a deathlike coma of at least one hour instead of dying, with further lethal damage ignorable via reapplication until Stamina drops to 1 or Essence runs out. Medical Charms tree (Intelligence-keyed); a joint Stamina/Perception/Intelligence branch link.

name: Multifunction Hypodermic Apparatus
summary: A retractable torso-mounted needle-tendril that injects synthesized drugs from internal storage, starting with any two of a large catalog of formulas (Paralytic Toxin, Lethal Toxin, Acid, Antivenin, Anesthetic, Immune Booster, Antiseptic, Healing Agent, Coagulant, Hallucinogen, Stimulant, Time Release Drug, Memory Eraser, Triggered Activation Drug), with more purchasable individually.
description: The tendril extends up to two yards to target veins/vital clusters; injecting an unwilling patient requires a Dexterity + Medicine attack roll (against soft targets a hit injects with no damage; against hard targets it deals piercing '1L + successes' damage but records no actual injury, only delivering the drug), while willing patients need no roll and self-injection is allowed. Harmful drugs allow the patient a reflexive Stamina + Resistance roll (difficulty = the Exalt's Essence) unless a special formula states otherwise; beneficial drugs normally bypass this resistance. Installation grants any two starting formulas; each additional costs 4 experience points/2 bonus points (or the Exalt may design new formulas of comparable power via Intelligence + (Medicine or Lore), difficulty 3, with Storyteller approval, for the same 4-experience-point cost). Formula summary: Paralytic/Lethal Toxin (bashing or lethal damage plus an action-die penalty scaled by Intelligence/Essence, reduced on a successful resistance roll; Stamina-exceeds-Intelligence targets are immune); Acid (flat 6L unsoakable-but-for-natural-soak damage, no resistance roll, permanently scarring Appearance -1 on 3+ damage); Antivenin (cures one active poison per dose, cleanses alcohol/drugs, can be pre-administered to intercept one future poison, and can neutralize an inert time-release/triggered dose but not memory eraser); Anesthetic (subtracts Essence from wound penalties, fading at one die/hour, resettable rather than stacking on reinjection); Immune Booster (+1 die vs. disease for Intelligence-many days); Antiseptic (prevents/nullifies wound infection); Healing Agent (heals 2 bashing levels after an hour of rest); Coagulant (instantly stops bleeding); Hallucinogen (synesthesia/pleasure with an Intelligence+Essence action penalty on failure, addictive per a monthly Temperance roll, difficulty 2, decaying an hour at a time; a lesser non-addictive version on success); Stimulant (reduces fatigue penalty by Essence for Intelligence-many hours, but repeated doses without rest inflict 2 unsoakable bashing levels each); Time Release Drug (delays any other injected drug's onset to a specified time, cleansable in advance by Antivenin); Memory Eraser (Essence 3+, 6 xp/3 bp; erases the past hour/scene on a failed Wits-based resistance, or scrambles recent memory recoverable turn-by-turn on success; cannot be a starting formula); Triggered Activation Drug (Essence 3+, 6 xp/3 bp; delays any injected drug's activation for up to a month via 1 additional committed mote until the Exalt disarms or triggers it; cannot be a starting formula). Medical Charms tree (Intelligence-keyed); root of the Intelligence branch.
prerequisiteText: Transitory or Sustained Augmentation of Intelligence, Diagnostic Sensor Apparatus

name: Regenerative Essence Transfusion
summary: A Multifunction Hypodermic Apparatus upgrade that either injects mortals with an Exalt-grade healing drug or lets the Alchemical directly transfer Essence to (or drain it from) a patient through the same needle.
description: Healing mode (10 motes, indefinite): injects a glowing healing fluid (using the Apparatus's injection rules) that lets mortal patients heal and resist poison/disease as if they were Exalted for as long as the Exalt commits 10 motes; it cannot speed up beings that already regenerate at Exalt speed or better. Transfer mode: after a successful injection, spend 3 motes to activate a transfer and then donate up to (Stamina + Essence) motes from her own pool to the patient, visibly flowing through the tendril; alternately she may siphon Essence as an attack for 2 motes, rolling Intelligence + Medicine (difficulty 1 if willing, or the target's Essence if unwilling), draining 2 motes into her own pool per success (draining Peripheral before Personal from Exalted victims). Medical Charms tree (Intelligence-keyed).
cost: 10 motes, or varies; Installation Cost: None.
prerequisiteText: Biostasis Field Projector, Multifunction Hypodermic Apparatus

name: Metabolic Augmentation Injection
summary: A Multifunction Hypodermic Apparatus upgrade that injects a highly addictive drug temporarily boosting a living patient's Physical Attributes, Appearance, Perception, Wits, and select Abilities, with prolonged use able to mutate the gains into permanent Traits.
description: Uses the Apparatus's injection rules (no resistance roll possible). For every 3 motes spent, raises one of the patient's Physical Attributes, Appearance, Perception, or Wits by one dot (extra Stamina also reduces wound penalties and grants Exalt-style soak/healing); for 1 mote per dot, raises Athletics, Awareness, Endurance, or Resistance. No Trait may be raised by more dots than (the Exalt's Essence minus the patient's permanent Essence), no Attribute may exceed double its original rating, and no Ability may exceed 5 dots after augmentation. Bonuses last as long as Essence is committed; patients carrying the drug a week or more may 'mutate,' letting players later pay experience points to make an augmented rating permanent up to its normal maximum or the augmented value, bypassing training time (Storytellers may instead require future-experience credit). Alchemicals themselves never mutate from carrying the drug, though other Exalted may. The drug is highly addictive to mortals: given a chance to reinject within a month, a mortal's player must roll Temperance (difficulty 2), doing anything short of endangering himself/loved ones on a failure, or anything at all on a botch. Medical Charms tree (Intelligence-keyed).
prerequisiteText: Biostasis Field Projector, Multifunction Hypodermic Apparatus

name: Imprinted Data Cluster
summary: Adamant memory-crystal brain implants that let an Alchemical download Ability specialties from a Vats Complex database one mote at a time, storing as many different specialties as desired at the cost of continuous Essence commitment.
description: For every mote spent (only while resting in a Vats Complex), the character downloads one Ability specialty from the facility's databases. Downloaded specialties count as natural specialties for dice-boosting-limit purposes (max three copies of the same specialty per Ability, max three natural specialty dice per roll), but unlike experience-bought specialties they vanish immediately and irrevocably if the Exalt ever withdraws the committed mote, requiring a fresh Vats download to reacquire. A character may store as many distinct specialties as desired simultaneously. Players may spend 3 experience points as an instantaneous reflexive action to release a downloaded specialty's Essence commitment and make it permanent. Cognitive Charms tree (Intelligence-keyed); root of the tree.
cost: 1 mote per dot (specialty); Installation Cost: 2 motes.

name: Clarified Data Assimilator
summary: A swarm of microscopic automata woven through an Alchemical's nervous system that substitutes her total Clarity rating for any single Ability's rating on one roll, at an escalating mote cost and a cumulative Clarity toll for repeated use.
description: Each activation replaces the rating of any single chosen Ability with the Exalt's total Clarity for the purposes of one roll (pertinent specialties for the replaced Ability still apply); the base cost is 3 motes, but each subsequent activation adds a cumulative mote to the cost, decreasing by 1 mote for every full day since the character last used the Charm. Characters may not channel a Virtue to aid a roll boosted by this Charm. Installing it grants 1 dot of permanent Clarity, and each use adds 1 point of temporary Clarity. Cognitive Charms tree (Intelligence-keyed).
cost: 3 motes (rising cumulatively with repeated same-day use); Installation Cost: 1 mote.
prerequisiteText: Transitory or Sustained Augmentation of Intelligence

name: Abstract Abacus Implant
summary: Artificial synapse webs that let an Alchemical reduce the difficulty of (and add automatic successes to) logic-based Mental Attribute rolls, act as a perfect free mental clock, and, via a submodule, rapidly learn spoken/written languages.
description: For every 2 motes spent, reduce the difficulty of a logic/deduction-based Mental Attribute roll (math, navigation/cartography, solving enigmas, etc.) by 1; once difficulty hits 1, further 2-mote increments instead add automatic successes, capped at the Exalt's permanent Essence. Also functions as a free, costless perfect mental clock/timer. Interpolative Syntax Emulator submodule (2 bonus points/4 experience points, Essence 3+): after an hour studying a text or listening to an unfamiliar language (or a turn studying a Mind-Ripping Probe victim's linguistic knowledge), the Exalt may spend 3 motes and 3 experience points (or 1 experience point for a tribal language) to instantly learn that tongue, without raising her Linguistics rating or needing separate expenditure for the written vs. spoken form. Cognitive Charms tree (Intelligence-keyed).
cost: 2 motes per success/difficulty point; Installation Cost: 1 mote.
prerequisiteText: Transitory or Sustained Augmentation of Intelligence

name: Technological Analysis Engrams
summary: A metallic brain sub-lobe giving an Alchemical an intuitive engineering database, letting her study any machine or artifact for a turn to learn its function, condition, and (with enough successes) repair/sabotage bonuses.
description: Requires only visual scrutiny for devices with visible components, or a turn of handling/running hands over hidden-mechanism devices. Roll Perception + Lore at the end of the turn: difficulty 1-2 for non-magical devices (2 for the most complex/strange), or the item's artifact rating for artifacts (difficulty 6 for N/A-rated artifacts). One success gives a general functional understanding; two also reveal damage/maintenance needs and degree; three give a precise understanding of all capabilities and condition details. A failure gives nothing; a botch gives Storyteller-supplied erroneous details. Repeated study of the same object doesn't stack results. Two or more successes bank one automatic success toward the character's next repair roll on that item that scene, or (alternative use) double the raw damage of her next attack meant to destroy it; only one such banked bonus can be held at a time regardless of reuse. Cognitive Charms tree (Perception-keyed).
prerequisiteText: Transitory or Sustained Augmentation of Perception, Abstract Abacus Implant

name: Omnitool Implant
summary: A hand implant letting an Alchemical extrude any simple tool she has the relevant dotted Ability to use, from screwdrivers to welding torches, for narrative and constructive (not combat) purposes.
description: Fingers unfold into tools, or a wrist-mounted stalk extends one if all fingers are occupied; the Exalt can generate any tool needed for an Ability she has at least one dot in (e.g. Craft (Culinary) cutlery, Craft (Locksmithing) lockpicks). One activation supplies as many exchangeable tools as needed for the rest of the scene; the Storyteller vetoes abuse. Tools are high quality, adding one specialty-style die to any roll using them. Blunt/sharp tools can serve as crude improvised weapons (-1 accuracy from normal) but this is the Charm's combat ceiling; interrogators can misuse tools given time and a restrained victim, but this has no bearing on combat. Purely cosmetic, no-real-benefit uses (lighting a pipe, buffing nails) may be allowed by the Storyteller for free. Cognitive Charms tree (Wits-keyed); root of the Wits branch.
prerequisiteText: Transitory or Sustained Augmentation of Wits

name: Synaptic Acceleration Node
summary: Nervous-system relay crystals that multiply an Alchemical's mental processing speed by her permanent Essence for a paid number of hours, useful for planning agendas or drafting blueprints.
description: For a number of hours equal to motes spent (2 motes per hour), the Exalt's cognition rate multiplies by her permanent Essence: divide the time required for Mental Attribute-based actions (or the interval between rolls in extended actions) by her Essence. For quick mental tasks of a turn or less, she may perform up to her Wits rating of them per turn, with the usual multiple-action penalty reduced by her permanent Essence. Cognitive Charms tree (Wits-keyed).
cost: 2 motes per hour; Installation Cost: 1 mote.
prerequisiteText: Transitory or Sustained Augmentation of Wits

name: Incomparable Efficiency Upgrade
summary: A Synaptic Acceleration Node upgrade letting an Alchemical multiply the speed at which she performs a declared, predominantly physical extended task (e.g. digging a ditch, crafting an artifact) by her permanent Essence, though it cannot speed up learning.
description: On activation, the player declares a non-combat extended action lasting more than a turn; while the Exalt commits the required Essence and works without interruptions longer than five cumulative minutes per hour, her working speed on that task multiplies by her permanent Essence. It cannot shorten Ability training or Trait advancement time (speed-reading a manual teaches the content but not practiced skill). The character's movements become clipped and mechanical while under the effect. The Storyteller is the final arbiter of which tasks qualify. Cognitive Charms tree (Wits-keyed).

name: Logic Engineering Lobe
summary: A planning Charm letting an Alchemical precompute a declared future action, reducing its eventual difficulty at 3 motes per point, provided she actually follows through with the plan on the next turn.
description: The player declares an action the Exalt intends to take next turn; the Storyteller states the most likely difficulty given known information. For every 3 motes spent, the final difficulty drops by 1 (usable once per turn). If the character deviates from the declared plan on the following turn, the spent Essence is wasted; if she follows through, the difficulty decreases as purchased (spending more than needed to hit difficulty 1 wastes the excess). Storytellers are encouraged to award stunt dice for players who declare intentions aloud to incredulous opponents in play. Cognitive Charms tree (Wits-keyed).
cost: 3 motes per difficulty point; Installation Cost: 1 mote.
prerequisiteText: Abstract Abacus Implant, Synaptic Acceleration Node

name: Eidetic Processing Core
summary: A permanent brain implant of memory-indexing microscopic automata granting an Alchemical perfect recall of anything experienced since installation, and resistance to memory tampering.
description: The Exalt perfectly remembers anything experienced while the Charm was installed with no roll required. Recalling pre-installation memories requires a reflexive Wits + Awareness roll (difficulty 1, once per turn per specific memory); failure means the automata have trouble locating an imperfectly filed memory, while a botch relocates it into an inaccessible synaptic cluster for the rest of the scene. Against memory-tampering or memory-erasing effects, an opposed roll of the Alchemical's Wits + Awareness versus the aggressor's Manipulation + Performance decides whether the Eidetic Processing Core sees through the change (Alchemical wins) or is fooled, reporting erasures as blank patches and false memories as real (aggressor wins). Cognitive Charms tree (Wits-keyed).
prerequisiteText: Transitory or Sustained Augmentation of Wits

name: Auxiliary Essence Storage Unit
summary: A permanent Charm that expands an Alchemical's Peripheral Essence reservoir by 10 motes per installation, capped by permanent Essence (or Essence x 5 at Essence 8+), and barred from Arrays.
description: Each installation adds 10 additional motes of Peripheral Essence capacity. Exalted cannot install more copies than their permanent Essence (or permanent Essence x 5 for Alchemicals of Essence 8+). This Charm can never be placed in an Array. Essence and Weaving Charms tree; root of the tree (not Attribute-keyed).

name: Man-Machine Weaving Engine
summary: An adamant ring implanted around an Alchemical's soulgem that lets her initiate a single Man-Machine protocol of Alchemical weaving she has separately learned, at the cost of a permanent dot of Clarity and never being removable or Array-eligible.
description: Activating for 1 Willpower spins the ring and lights runes; the character then spends the required Essence to initiate a single known Man-Machine weaving protocol, taking effect after a shaping period comparable to Emerald Circle Sorcery, with a bright soulgem flash marking the effect. Installing this Charm grants 1 dot of permanent Clarity; it can never be removed and can never be placed in an Array. The full catalog of Man-Machine protocols and their effects is explicitly cross-referenced in-book to pp. 145-159 (PDF 146-160), which falls in Chapter Four (Miracles of the Machine God), not this chapter. Essence and Weaving Charms tree; root of the tree (Intelligence-keyed, but not gated behind an Augmentation-of-Attribute prerequisite).

name: God-Machine Weaving Engine
summary: A larger concentric adamant ring surrounding the Man-Machine Weaving Engine, letting an Alchemical initiate a far more powerful God-Machine weaving protocol over two turns of shaping, again at the cost of a permanent dot of Clarity and non-removability.
description: Activating for 2 Willpower spins both rings in opposite directions with a storm of sparks; the character designates a single known God-Machine protocol and spends its Essence cost, and after two turns of shaping (comparable to Sapphire Circle Sorcery) the protocol takes effect with a display rivaling the noonday sun. Installing this Charm grants 1 dot of permanent Clarity; it can never be removed and can never be placed in an Array. As with the Man-Machine Weaving Engine, the full catalog of God-Machine protocols is cross-referenced in-book to pp. 145-159 (PDF 146-160) in Chapter Four, not this chapter. Essence and Weaving Charms tree (Intelligence-keyed, but not gated behind an Augmentation-of-Attribute prerequisite).
prerequisiteText: Auxiliary Essence Storage Unit, Man-Machine Weaving Engine
